what: Banco Santander is a Spanish bank with large retail operations in Spain, the UK, Brazil, Mexico and the US, plus a big consumer-finance business in car loans.
customers: More than 170 million customers: households, small businesses and companies.
money: deposits, mortgages and loans in Europe and the Americas
Corporate and investment banking, wealth and payments
wholesale banking, insurance, asset management, payments
moat: Scale across Europe and Latin America, with profits spread over many countries.
risks: Loan losses and politics in Latin America
opportunities: Analysts see about 25% upside from current levels
Brazilian and Mexican operations earn returns well above its European business
Large buybacks have shrunk the share count substantially
watch: Return on tangible equity and credit costs in Latin America.
